status_as_of_cutoff: Sioux Falls officially approved Gemini's rezoning and amended preliminary plan on 2026-01-06. The official minutes show the preliminary-plan motion initially failed 3–4, a water-meter condition amendment passed 4–3, and Resolution 4-26 passed 7–0; the rezoning action was also recorded 7–0. A later local report says a referendum petition was rejected. No building permit, groundbreaking, construction, inspection, CO, utility/interconnection, energization, commissioning, or live-service evidence was located.
